meta.title: Dionatã Bergmann — Frontend and Mobile Engineer
meta.description: Frontend and Mobile Engineer with React, Next.js, React Native, and TypeScript. Enterprise ERP, micro-frontends, apps on the App Store and Google Play, and an MBA in Frontend Engineering from FIAP.

description: Frontend and Mobile Engineer with 4+ years of experience building products with React, Next.js, React Native, and TypeScript. I work on high-traffic enterprise ERP software, micro-frontend migrations, and international apps published on the App Store and Google Play, with REST and GraphQL integrations. MBA in Frontend Engineering (FIAP). I also support backend work with Node.js and NestJS.

aboutMe.title: About Me
aboutMe.description: My first contact with programming was in 2015, with a Minecraft server that reached 90 simultaneous players. After high school, I looked for a field that combined creativity and impact, and in 2019 I found it in technology. Since then, I've worked on real products: from consulting with 15+ projects and 3,000+ daily active users to enterprise ERP software and international mobile apps, with 10+ apps published on the stores. Today I balance production delivery with continuous learning (FIAP MBA in Frontend Engineering), focusing on front-end architecture, performance, accessibility, and user experience.
